name: Safa Systems & Technologies Limited
summary: Safa Systems & Technologies Ltd. is a firm primarily involved in the wholesale distribution of consumer electronic goods. The company was co-founded by Faizal Bavaraparambil Abdul Khader and Bavaraparambil Abdhulkadher Hydrose on October 18, 2012, and its corporate headquarters are located in Ernakulam, India.
